predictions.claim: AI model quality will improve roughly 10x (an order of magnitude) per year as recursive self-improvement takes hold — and that figure may prove conservative.
predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya (Gavin Baker concurs)
predictions.notes: Baker said the 10x-per-year claim 'might seem conservative' if recursive self-improvement is unlocked.

predictions.claim: SpaceX will close its first day of public trading above a $2T market cap.
predictions.speaker: Polymarket (cited by hosts, 71% odds)
predictions.notes: IPO expected mid-June, likely June 12; ticker SPCX.

predictions.claim: Orbital/space-based compute will become a reality between the second half of 2028 and the first half of 2030.
predictions.speaker: Gavin Baker
predictions.notes: Baker notes a working Nvidia H100 is already in orbit, trained on and used for inference by Karpathy.

predictions.claim: SpaceX will achieve rapid (multiple-times-per-day) reusability of Starship within a year or two.
predictions.speaker: Gavin Baker
predictions.notes: Stated ahead of a Starbase launch he was attending that day; 'maybe sooner.'

predictions.claim: SpaceX's terrestrial data-center business alone will reach $100-200B in revenue by 2030-2032.
predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.notes: Used to justify buying SpaceX at ~20x revenue on terrestrial data centers alone.

predictions.claim: Tesla will eventually be merged into SpaceX/Elon's combined entity ('$ELON').
predictions.speaker: Chamath Palihapitiya
predictions.notes: Combined market cap would rank ~4th largest company in the world per the hosts.

predictions.claim: US May CPI will come in at 4.2% or higher, with professional forecasters projecting CPI toward 6% in Q2 — flipping the Fed narrative from cuts to possible hikes.
predictions.speaker: Jason Calacanis (citing Polymarket / Survey of Professional Forecasters)
predictions.notes: Polymarket cited at 99% for the ≥4.2% May print.

predictions.claim: Rising global long-term yields (Japan 30-year at 5.1%, US 10-year at 4.6%) could be the catalyst for a credit crisis via unwinding carry trades.
predictions.speaker: David Friedberg
predictions.notes: Hedged as something for active market participants/economists to confirm.
